ModMetaData.name: Immersive Raid Compression
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces oversized late-game human raids, mechanoid raids, manhunter packs, and mech cluster defenders without hidden stat buffs. Homogeneous pure-role mechanoid swarms using vanilla edge-walk or edge-drop arrival can enter in controlled waves from the original edge anchor as active combat power falls. Mixed forces use same-role vanilla promotion. Breach, boss-led, center/random drop, grouped, and water-arrival raids stay outside generic wave handling. Deferred mechs and wave state are saved. The in-game audit page shows classification, wave state, before/after composition, and tactical proof.
通过原版高阶单位替换或安全的分批入场，减少后期人类、机械体、食人动物和机械集群同时存在的单位数，不添加隐藏属性 Buff。采用原版地图边缘步入或边缘空投的单一职责机械海，会在有效战力下降时从原始边缘锚点继续增援；混编继续使用同职责原版高阶替换。破墙、头目、中心/随机空投、分组及水中出现不会进入通用分批。待增援机械体和波次状态会写入存档，记录页面显示完整分类与波次过程。
